title: History
d: Allegiant Stadium opened in 2020. The Death Star in the desert..

description: The history of Allegiant Stadium begins in 2020. The Death Star in the desert. Like all great grounds, it has been rebuilt, renamed, and reborn — stands rising where terraces stood, roofs arriving decades after the first kick. Its timeline is the timeline of its tenants' triumphs and the city's love affair with the game.

title: Architecture

Renovations keep adding hospitality while trying not to dilute the soul.

title: The tenants
d: Allegiant Stadium is home to Raiders.
definition: Allegiant Stadium is home to Raiders.
description: Allegiant Stadium belongs to Raiders — and to the fans who fill it. The tenant-club bond defines the ground's identity: the songs, the rituals, the expectation. When the team thrives the stadium shakes; when it struggles the old ground groans with it. You cannot separate the venue from its people.

title: Finals hosted

title: Concerts and events

description: Beyond sport, Allegiant Stadium hosts concerts, ceremonies, and mega-events — the biggest stages need the biggest rooms. The ground's event history reads like pop culture itself. Multi-use keeps the economics working, though purists always prefer the roar of a matchday to anything else.
